collin2022.citation: Collin, L. (8 June 2022). Message to the xz-devel mailing list, msg00567.
claims: The maintainer described xz as an unpaid hobby project.
collin2022.quote: this is an unpaid hobby project

collin2022b.citation: Collin, L. (29 June 2022). Message to the xz-devel mailing list, msg00571.
claims: The maintainer called the contributor practically a co-maintainer.
collin2022b.does_not_prove: Anything about the contributor's intent at that time.

cox-timeline.short: Cox 2024, timeline of the xz attack
cox-timeline.citation: Cox, R. (2024). Timeline of the xz open source attack. research.swtch.com.
claims: First patch from the contributor 2021-10-29; xz 5.6.0 tagged 2024-02-24.
cox-timeline.does_not_prove: Its dates are a secondary compilation linking primary messages.

tukaani.citation: Collin, L. XZ Utils backdoor. tukaani.org.
claims: The 5.6.0 and 5.6.1 release tarballs were created and signed by the contributor.
tukaani.quote: created and signed by Jia Tan

freund2024.citation: Freund, A. (29 March 2024). backdoor in upstream xz/liblzma leading to ssh server compromise. oss-security mailing list.
claims: Part of the backdoor existed solely in the distributed tarballs; sshd logins took about 0.5 s against about 0.01 s, which led to the discovery.
freund2024.does_not_prove: That any provenance system would have caught it; most of the payload was in the repository.

nvd2024.citation: National Vulnerability Database. CVE-2024-3094, published 29 March 2024, CVSS 3.1 base 10.0.
claims: Malicious code was discovered in the upstream tarballs of xz, starting with version 5.6.0.
nvd2024.quote: discovered in the upstream tarballs of xz

hardin1968.citation: Hardin, G. (1968). The Tragedy of the Commons. Science 162(3859), 1243-1248. Read via the Garrett Hardin Society reprint; the publisher page returned 403.
claims: Hardin wrote that freedom in a commons brings ruin to all, and proposed mutual coercion mutually agreed upon by the majority of the people affected.
hardin1968.quote: Freedom in a commons brings ruin to all.
hardin1968.does_not_prove: Anything empirical; it is an argument.

ostrom2010.citation: Ostrom, E. (2010). Beyond Markets and States: Polycentric Governance of Complex Economic Systems. American Economic Review 100(3), 641-672 (Nobel Prize lecture, 8 December 2009).
claims: Eight design principles of long-enduring common-pool resource institutions.
Of over 100 studies reviewed by Cox, Arnold and Villamayor-Tomas, two-thirds confirm the principles.
Across 178 forest user groups, monitoring was strongly correlated with forest density.
ostrom2010.quote: authorized to participate in making and modifying its rules
ostrom2010.does_not_prove: That the principles hold for digital commons; the evidence is correlational field work on natural resources, and a third of the reviewed studies did not confirm them.

longpre2023.short: Longpre et al. 2023, Data Provenance Initiative
longpre2023.citation: Longpre, S., Mahari, R., Chen, A., et al. (2023). The Data Provenance Initiative: A Large Scale Audit of Dataset Licensing and Attribution in AI. arXiv:2310.16787v3.
claims: Of 1,858 datasets, licences were unspecified on GitHub 72%, Hugging Face 69%, Papers with Code 70%; the authors' tracing left 30% unspecified.
Licences listed more permissively than the author's terms: 29% (GitHub), 27% (Hugging Face), 16% (Papers with Code).
longpre2023.interval: None; counts over a curated sample.
longpre2023.does_not_prove: Downstream harm or legal exposure; the sample is popular fine-tuning collections.

longpre2024.short: Longpre et al. 2024, Consent in Crisis
longpre2024.citation: Longpre, S., Mahari, R., Lee, A., et al. (2024). Consent in Crisis: The Rapid Decline of the AI Data Commons. arXiv:2407.14933v2.
claims: From April 2023 to April 2024, about 5% or more of all tokens in C4 became fully restricted by robots.txt (body: about 1% to 5-7%).
longpre2024.interval: None; the authors say values may be slightly high owing to Wayback Machine gaps.
longpre2024.does_not_prove: Crawler compliance, or that loss of provenance caused the restrictions.

claims: Provenance is verifiable information about software artifacts describing where, when and how something was produced.
slsa12.quote: where, when, and how something was produced
slsa12.does_not_prove: That the source is benign, or how widely it is adopted.
